README.md says the module “prepares and executes” transfers while stating preview/execution policy is undocumented; src/transfer-operation.ts only returns `submitted` or `preview` objects and contains no external transfer call.

The actor asks one focused decision: whether the project submits value-bearing transfers to an external system or only prepares/models transfer-operation state. This directly resolves the consequential ambiguity evidenced by README.md and src/transfer-operation.ts.

The actor reports an invalid inspection containing the two missing-foundation diagnostics. Deterministic post-actor evidence independently confirms inspectionStatus, cliValidateStatus, and cliInspectStatus are all `invalid`, with a valid CLI envelope and no harness failures.
